描述_EN: . the v&a has around 650 ancient and medieval textiles recovered from the silk road by stein at the beginning of the20th century. the site is also part of an area of central asia we now call the silk road, a series of overland trade routes that crossed asia from china to europe. the site of loulan is remarkable for the carved wooden capitals, beams and balustrades that show clear affinities with western classical decoration that filtered through iran and northwest india. the site of loulan is remarkable for the carved wooden capitals, beams and balustrades that show clear affinities with western classical decoration that filtered through iran and northwest india . it is unclear what this textile would have been used for, although it is likely to have had a utilitarian function as well as a decorative purpose. whilst silk textiles travelled west from china, buddhism entered china from india in this way. camels and horses were used as pack animals and merchants passed the goods from oasis to oasis. this textile was brought back from central asia by the explorer and archaeologist sir marc aurel stein (1862-1943). the most notable item traded was silk. the silk road was also important for the exchange of ideas. it was recovered from the site of loulan, which dates from the 3rd to the 4th century ad. some are silk while others are made from the wool of a variety of different animals. this piece of tapestry woven wool shows bands in red, pale pink, white, pale blue, blue and broader bands of red. these latter bands have additional decorations in contrasting colours.
描述_ZN: . V&A有大约650件古代和中世纪的纺织品，是斯坦在20世纪初从丝绸之路上找到的。 该遗址也是中亚地区的一部分，我们现在称之为丝绸之路，这是一系列从中国到欧洲穿越亚洲的陆上贸易路线。 楼兰遗址因其雕刻的木制柱头、横梁和栏杆而引人注目，这些木制柱头、横梁和栏杆显示出与通过伊朗和印度西北部的西方古典装饰的明显联系。 楼兰遗址因其雕刻的木质柱头、横梁和栏杆而引人注目，这些木质柱头、横梁和栏杆显示了与通过伊朗和印度西北部的西方古典装饰的明显联系。 目前还不清楚这种纺织品的用途，尽管它很可能具有功利性功能和装饰性目的。 年，当丝织品从中国西行时，佛教通过这种方式从印度进入中国。 年，骆驼和马被用作驮运动物，商人们在绿洲之间传递货物。 年，这个纺织品被探险家和考古学家Marc Aurel Stein先生（1862-1943）从中亚带回来。 年，最引人注目的贸易项目是丝绸。 年：丝绸之路对于思想的交流也很重要。 它是在楼兰遗址中发现的，可以追溯到公元3-4世纪。 有些是丝绸，有些则是由各种不同动物的羊毛制成。 这块羊毛织锦显示了红色、淡粉色、白色、淡蓝色、蓝色和更广泛的红色带。 这些后面的带子有对比色的附加装饰。
